evidence.detail: The class extends org.pushingpixels.substance.api.shaper.ClassicButtonShaper and overrides getCornerRadius(AbstractButton,float) to return exactly 0.0f.
The only exact-v308 owner/constructor path is R22 rs/gui/b RuneLiteSkin, which installs this shaper into the RuneLite Substance skin configuration.
R177 owns a separate rs/ui/c/b RuneLiteSquareButtonShaper family. This raw class belongs specifically to the older R22 rs/gui/b RuneLiteSkin surface, so the semantic name is kept distinct.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the zero-radius ClassicButtonShaper owned by R22 RuneLiteSkin; no standalone upstream source identifier is claimed.
